auditMetadata.engine: JobXApply Organic Discoverability Audit Engine v2.0
auditMetadata.auditScope: Full Codebase, Routes, Architecture, Robots, Sitemaps, Schema, Core Web Vitals, AEO & GEO

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: Specific AI user-agent records (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.) in robots.txt lacked Disallow directives, exposing /admin/ and private routes to AI crawler isolation under RFC 9309.
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Consolidated AI crawler directive block ensuring Disallow: /admin/, /api/, /database/, and all 11 private routes are explicitly enforced across both generic and AI crawlers.

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: 8 high-intent public tools and career guides were completely missing from sitemap.xml (only 13 URLs existed).
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Built scripts/generate-sitemap.js generating all 24 public URLs with daily/weekly changefreq, lastmod, priorities, and image metadata.

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: 11 private authenticated and utility routes lacked noindex tags, risking duplicate content and indexing of auth flows.
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Injected <meta name='robots' content='noindex, nofollow'> into dashboard.html, settings.html, profile-setup.html, auth.html, auth-callback.html, reset-password.html, apply-sandbox.html, autofill-lab.html, maintenance.html, 404.html, and onboarding.html.

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: index.html loaded an unused 600KB Three.js script and synchronous D3/TopoJSON in <head>, blocking First Contentful Paint.
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Removed unused Three.js dependency and added defer attribute to D3 and TopoJSON libraries.

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: cursor: none CSS rules on body and button broke screen magnifiers and keyboard accessibility.
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Replaced cursor: none with standard cursor: default and cursor: pointer across index.html.

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: index.html contained unsubstantiated AggregateRating (1,280 reviews, 4.9 score) with no on-page reviews, violating Google Search Central policies.
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Removed fake aggregate rating while preserving valid Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, and HowTo schema entities.

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: Footer on index.html contained only privacy and terms links; navigation was injected dynamically by JS, leaving deep pages isolated from static crawlers.
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Built a crawlable 4-column static HTML footer link grid connecting all 24 public tools, ecosystem pages, guides, and legal pages.

coreDeficienciesResolved.issue: blog.html title had legacy 'CareerHub // Blog' branding.
coreDeficienciesResolved.resolution: Updated title to 'JobXApply // Blog & Career Intelligence' with complete canonical and OG tags.
